children: Hao Feng Group filed an F-1 for its initial public offering on September 11, 2026. The Hong Kong-based investment education company plans to list on the NYSE American under the ticker “HFE,” offering 3,200,000 ordinary shares at an expected price range of $5.00 to $8.00 per share. Proceeds are earmarked for regional expansion, technology upgrades, course development, and working capital.

Hao Feng Group is a Hong Kong-based provider of investment and financial education focused on retail and high‑net‑worth investors. Through its operating subsidiary, Hao Feng International Limited, the company delivers on‑site classes, live online sessions, and subscription‑based digital content covering topics such as trading, market analysis, portfolio construction, fundamental analysis, and options strategies. The founder and CEO is a veteran asset manager (Type 9 SFC license holder), and the curriculum blends real‑world market insights with structured learning.

The company generates revenue across three segments: on‑site educational services, subscription‑based digital content (YouTube memberships), and advertising services via sponsored video placements on its YouTube channel. Competitive strengths include a multi‑channel delivery model, an experienced tutor team, and a focus on regulatory-aligned content. Hao Feng plans to expand regionally into markets such as Malaysia, Singapore, and potentially Taiwan, while upgrading its IT stack (including CRM), broadening its course catalog, and developing proprietary algorithms and financial models to enhance instruction and personalization.
: Hong Kong financial education market was ~$1.05 billion in 2024, projected to reach ~$2.23 billion by 2034.
: 7.8% projected CAGR for Hong Kong financial education (2025–2034); 2022–2024 CAGR of 3.9%.
: Ranked third among providers focused on retail and high-net-worth investors in Hong Kong in 2024 with ~0.15% share (BARENTSZ & CRI).
: Legendary Education Group, Money Tab, FQ Education Academy, The Investopedia Institute of Hong Kong (plus regional players in Malaysia and Taiwan).
: Rising retail participation, increased U.S. equities interest among Hong Kong investors, AI-driven education tools adoption, and expanding online delivery and subscription models.
: Student headcount rose to 493 in March 2026 from 416 in March 2025; FY2025 students ~490 vs. ~430 in FY2024; over 32% of FY2025 students subscribed for more than three years.
: One tuition center in Hong Kong (Kwun Tong).
: Primarily Hong Kong; planned expansion to Malaysia, Singapore, and potentially Taiwan.
: Sponsored content with two licensed Hong Kong financial institutions (exclusive title sponsorships in Feb–Apr 2026); membership content via YouTube.
: H1 FY2026 revenue mix—On‑site education 82.3%, subscription content 3.9%, advertising 13.8%.

, Founder, Chairman & Chief Executive Officer - Veteran asset manager with 16+ years’ experience; SFC Type 9 license holder; former fund manager at Oriens Asset Management; media contributor and investment educator.
, Chief Financial Officer - Certified Public Accountant in Hong Kong; 10+ years’ finance/audit experience at PKF, Moore Stephens, JLL, and Hong Kong Arts Centre.
, Independent Director - Corporate finance and legal background; former director at Anglo Chinese Corporate Finance; CFA and FRM charterholder; Principal Lawyer at Trio Partners (Australia).
, Independent Director - Education professional with bilingual communication experience; CELTA-certified; background in program planning and student engagement.
, Independent Director - Senior educator and academic affairs lead; experience in IT-enhanced teaching and assessment; TSA English Oral Examiner.
: Approximately $20.8 million at the $6.50 midpoint (3,200,000 shares; 45-day over-allotment up to 480,000 shares)

: Global expansion (notably Malaysia, Singapore, and potentially Taiwan), IT upgrades including CRM, new course development, strengthening brand and tutor qualifications, development of self-built algorithms and financial models, and working capital.
